newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Two S.Korean firms buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Two S.Korean firms buy 21,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd said on Wednesday they bought combined 21,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat from Japanese trading house Nichimen Corp.
A Cheiljedang official said his company bought 12,000 tonnes at basis prices over July futures on U.S grain futures exchanges including the Chicago Board of Trade.
Dongah Flour bought the remaining 9,500 tonnes at fixed prices, the official said.
Shipment was set for May 5-June 5 to the western port of Inchon.
